title: What Is Optometry?
description: What is optometry, really? In this opening episode of Optometry Foundations, Focus Cast by focuslinks unpacks the word itself, traces the profession from thirteenth century spectacles to modern university degrees, and lays out the three pillars of eye care work. Learn why optometry is an autonomous, primary healthcare profession, and what really happens behind the frame racks. Made for students, optical shop teams, and curious patients who want a clear starting point.
